propositions: continuous auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing teardown-corrupted reviews to cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block automatic recovery
shutdown drain timeout (45s) is much shorter than per-review timeout (1200s), causing in-flight reviews to be cancelled before completion
backfill reconciler treats fail-closed votes as already-voted and skips re-driving, creating an invisible recovery loop when retryable errors occur
retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting and post no vote to allow backfill reconciler to re-drive without suppression

terminal conditions (indeterminate, finding) should continue to cast fail-closed votes; escalation after N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision should vote -1 with exhaustion note and emit alerting metric
drain quiesce window must be sized to full review timeout (1200s) and stop_grace_period must be increased to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete without interruption
